reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the rule's preferred position is the absence of any non-solicit binding Customer; the cited paragraphs (§14.8 Personnel — supervision/assignment/subcontracting only; §14.16 Freedom of Action — parties free to contract with others) contain no solicitation, no-hire or inducement restriction, so the preferred position is met.

No redline and no counterparty comment were proposed, which is correct for a compliant finding — importing carve-out language would first require adding a restriction on the Customer that the Vendor has not sought.

The failed deterministic checks (duration ≤12 months; general-solicitation carve-out) are non-probative because both presuppose an existing non-solicit clause; with no such clause there is nothing to measure, and the rendered text is unchanged from the original.
Rationale is accurate, cites the playbook position, and correctly records this as internal evidence rather than a negotiation issue.
